context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 13 adds WebSocket real-time tracking and complete ride status flow. Key features: 1) WebSocket endpoint at /ws/{client_id} supports ping, join_ride, leave_ride, location_update messages. 2) Ride status transitions are validated: pending->accepted->arriving->in_progress->completed|cancelled. 3) Cancel endpoint returns cancellation_fee (0 for pending, vehicle_type.cancellation_fare for accepted/arriving). 4) RideTrackingPage at /ride/{rideId} shows map, status bar, driver info, OTP display. 5) DriverHome integrates WebSocket for real-time ride requests. NOTE: WebSocket works internally (ws://localhost:8001) but external wss:// may timeout due to ingress config.
